name: compile_batch.jcl.template
description:
This JCL defines and executes a reusable procedure (BLDBAT) that compiles a COBOL source program named ZZZZZZZZ from the CardDemo application library, then prints the compilation listing, and finally link-edits the compiled output into an executable load module stored in the CardDemo load library.Key Functionalities:
Compiles the COBOL source member ZZZZZZZZ from the CardDemo COBOL source library (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CBL) using the IBM Enterprise COBOL compiler (IGYCRCTL), referencing copybook members from AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CPY
Saves the compilation listing output to the CardDemo listing library (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTING) under member ZZZZZZZZ, then prints it to the system output using the IEBGENER utility
Link-edits the compiled object code into an executable load module and stores it as member ZZZZZZZZ in the CardDemo load library (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB), resolving external references from system and runtime libraries

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A CardDemo COBOL source program member exists in the source library AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CBL, identified by the member name supplied via the symbolic parameter &MEM (set to ZZZZZZZZ in this execution)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The COMPILE step is initiated for the specified member &MEM
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The COBOL compiler must locate and read the source program member &MEM from AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CBL as the primary input for compilation

rules.Rule_Name: COMPILE.BLDBAT - IGYCRCTL - Identify Source Program for Compilation
rules.Rule_Description: The compilation process must identify and read the correct CardDemo COBOL source program member before compilation begins. The program member is dynamically identified by the symbolic parameter &MEM, making the build procedure reusable across all CardDemo programs.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The COBOL source program member &MEM contains one or more COPY statements referencing shared data definitions, and the CardDemo copybook library AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CPY is available and accessible
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The COBOL compiler encounters a COPY statement within the source program during compilation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The compiler must resolve and include the referenced copybook definitions from AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CPY into the compiled program, ensuring all shared data structures and layouts are correctly incorporated

rules.Rule_Name: COMPILE.BLDBAT - IGYCRCTL - Resolve Shared Copybook Definitions
rules.Rule_Description: During compilation, all shared data structure definitions and common layouts referenced within the COBOL source program via COPY statements must be resolved from the CardDemo copybook library before the program can be successfully compiled.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The COMPILE step is initiated for a CardDemo COBOL source program member &MEM
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The COBOL compiler processes string literals within the source program
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The compiler must treat the apostrophe character (') as the string delimiter for all string literals in the source program, as enforced by the APOST compiler option

rules.Rule_Name: COMPILE.BLDBAT - IGYCRCTL - Apply Apostrophe as String Delimiter Standard
rules.Rule_Description: The CardDemo application enforces a coding standard that requires the apostrophe character to be used as the string delimiter in all COBOL source programs. This must be applied consistently during every compilation to ensure uniform interpretation of string literals across the application.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The COMPILE step is initiated for CardDemo COBOL source program member &MEM
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The COBOL compiler successfully processes the source program
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The compiler must generate a full source listing with sequential line numbers applied to every line of the source code, as enforced by the LIST and NUMBER compiler options

rules.Rule_Name: COMPILE.BLDBAT - IGYCRCTL - Generate Full Source Listing with Line Numbers
rules.Rule_Description: Every compilation of a CardDemo program must produce a complete source listing with line numbers to ensure full traceability of the source code. This supports auditability and debugging by providing a numbered record of every line of the compiled program.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The COMPILE step is initiated for CardDemo COBOL source program member &MEM
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The COBOL compiler successfully processes the source program and its data definitions
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The compiler must generate a complete data map showing all data structures, their hierarchies, and memory layouts as part of the compilation output, as enforced by the MAP compiler option

rules.Rule_Name: COMPILE.BLDBAT - IGYCRCTL - Generate Data Structure Map
rules.Rule_Description: Every compilation of a CardDemo program must produce a data map showing all data structures and their layouts. This provides developers and support teams with a detailed reference of how data is organized within the compiled program.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The COBOL compiler has completed processing of source program member &MEM and has produced a compilation report containing the source listing, data map, and any diagnostics
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The compilation step completes its processing
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The complete compilation report must be permanently written and saved to AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTING under member name &MEM, ensuring the listing is retained for future audit, review, and traceability purposes

rules.Rule_Name: COMPILE.BLDBAT - IGYCRCTL - Archive Permanent Compilation Listing
rules.Rule_Description: The full compilation report — including the source listing, data map, diagnostics, warnings, and errors — must be permanently saved to the CardDemo listing library under the same member name as the source program. This ensures a persistent audit trail and allows future review without re-running the compilation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The COBOL compiler has successfully compiled source program member &MEM from AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CBL
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The compiler must produce a compiled object module stored in the temporary dataset &&LOADSET and pass it forward to the LKED (link-edit) step for further processing; the temporary object module must be automatically deleted once the LKED step has consumed it

rules.Rule_Name: COMPILE.BLDBAT - IGYCRCTL - Produce Compiled Object Module for Linking
rules.Rule_Description: Upon successful compilation, the compiler must produce an intermediate compiled object module and make it available to the subsequent linking step. This object module is a transient artifact that exists only for the duration of the build job and is automatically discarded after linking is complete.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A compilation listing for the CardDemo program member (&MEM) has been saved to the CardDemo listing library (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTING) as a result of a prior compilation step
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The CBLPRINT step is executed using the IEBGENER copy utility with no filtering or transformation instructions applied (SYSIN is empty/DUMMY)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The complete and unmodified compilation listing for program member (&MEM) is copied in full from the CardDemo listing library and published directly to the system print spool, making the entire compilation report — including source code, data maps, diagnostics, warnings, and errors — immediately available for online viewing or printing by developers and support teams

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1.CBLPRINT - IEBGENER - Publish Compilation Listing to Print Spool
rules.Rule_Description: After the CardDemo COBOL program is compiled and its listing is saved to the listing library, this step retrieves the saved compilation listing for the specified program member and publishes it in full to the system print spool, making it immediately accessible for developer review without requiring direct library access.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A compiled object module (&&LOADSET) has been produced by the COMPILE step for CardDemo program member &MEM, AND the following libraries are available and accessible: IBM system link library (SYS1.LINKLIB), Cryptographic Services library (CSF.SCSFMOD0), IBM Language Environment link library (CEE.SCEELKED), IBM Language Environment extended link library (CEE.SCEELKEX), and the CardDemo application load library (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Linkage Editor (HEWL) is invoked with LIST and XREF options to process the compiled object module by searching the library chain in strict order — first IBM system routines, then Cryptographic Services modules, then Language Environment runtime, then Language Environment extensions, and finally other CardDemo application modules — to resolve all external program references
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A fully linked, production-ready executable load module is permanently stored in the CardDemo application load library (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB) under member name &MEM, AND the temporary compiled object module (&&LOADSET) is automatically deleted after successful consumption, AND a detailed cross-reference report and module map are written to the system print spool for developer review

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1.BLDBAT - HEWL - Deploy Compiled Program to CardDemo Application Library
rules.Rule_Description: The Linkage Editor combines the compiled object module of the CardDemo program with all required system and application libraries to produce a final executable load module, which is permanently stored in the CardDemo application load library under the same member name as the source program.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CardDemo program member &MEM has been compiled and its object module is ready for linking, AND the program contains external references that must be resolved against multiple system and application libraries
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Linkage Editor searches for external references to resolve them against the library chain
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: External references MUST be resolved in the following strict order: (1) IBM core system routines from SYS1.LINKLIB first, (2) Cryptographic Services modules from CSF.SCSFMOD0 second, (3) IBM Language Environment runtime routines from CEE.SCEELKED third, (4) IBM Language Environment extended runtime routines from CEE.SCEELKEX fourth, and (5) other CardDemo application load modules from AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB fifth — ensuring that system-level dependencies take precedence over application-level dependencies

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1.BLDBAT - HEWL - Enforce Library Resolution Search Order for CardDemo Programs
rules.Rule_Description: The Linkage Editor must resolve all external references in a strict, predefined library search sequence to ensure that system routines, cryptographic services, runtime environment, and CardDemo application modules are resolved in the correct priority order.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A CardDemo COBOL program member &MEM is being linked into a deployable executable
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Linkage Editor resolves external references during the link-edit process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Cryptographic Services library (CSF.SCSFMOD0) MUST be included in the library search chain, ensuring that any cryptographic or security-related functions referenced by the CardDemo program are resolved and available in the final executable — confirming that all CardDemo programs are built with mandatory cryptographic capability

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1.BLDBAT - HEWL - Enforce Cryptographic Services Dependency for CardDemo Programs
rules.Rule_Description: Every CardDemo program built through this procedure must be linked against the Cryptographic Services library (CSF.SCSFMOD0), establishing a mandatory dependency that ensures all CardDemo executables have access to encryption and security functions required for handling sensitive card data.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The compiled object module (&&LOADSET) has been passed from the COMPILE step to the LKED step with a disposition of OLD (exclusive access)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Linkage Editor completes processing of the compiled object module
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The compiled object module (&&LOADSET) MUST be automatically deleted after the LKED step completes — regardless of success or failure — ensuring that no intermediate compiled artifacts are retained after the link-edit process, and the only permanent output is the final executable stored in the CardDemo load library

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1.BLDBAT - HEWL - Enforce Single-Use and Automatic Cleanup of Compiled Object Module
rules.Rule_Description: The compiled object module (&&LOADSET) produced by the COMPILE step is a transient artifact that must be consumed exactly once by the Linkage Editor and automatically discarded after use, ensuring no intermediate build artifacts persist beyond the job execution.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A CardDemo COBOL source program identified by member name &MEM has been compiled and its object module is ready for linking
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Linkage Editor produces the final executable load module and writes it to the CardDemo application load library
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The executable load module MUST be stored in AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB under the member name &MEM — the identical name used to identify the source program in the COMPILE step — ensuring that the source program name, compilation listing name, and deployed executable name are all consistent and traceable to each other

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1.BLDBAT - HEWL - Maintain Member Name Consistency Between Source and Executable
rules.Rule_Description: The final executable load module stored in the CardDemo application load library must use the exact same member name as the original COBOL source program, ensuring a direct and traceable one-to-one relationship between source programs and their deployed executables.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A CardDemo program member &MEM is being linked and it contains references to other CardDemo application modules that have already been compiled and deployed to the CardDemo load library (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Linkage Editor searches the library chain to resolve all external program references
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The CardDemo application load library (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB) MUST be included as the fifth and final entry in the library search chain, allowing the program being built to successfully resolve calls to other CardDemo application modules — enabling inter-program communication and supporting the modular design of the CardDemo application

rules.Rule_Name: STEP1.BLDBAT - HEWL - Enable Inter-Program Calls Within CardDemo Application
rules.Rule_Description: The CardDemo application load library is included in the linker search chain, enabling the program being built to reference and call other already-deployed CardDemo application modules, supporting the modular architecture of the CardDemo application.

    START([Job Start
CardDemo Program Build and Deploy
Program Member - &MEM]):::start

    %% Job Steps
    COMPILE[COMPILE - IGYCRCTL
Translate COBOL Source Program into
Intermediate Compiled Object Module]:::process

    CBLPRINT[CBLPRINT - IEBGENER
Print Compilation Listing Report
to System Spool for Developer Review]:::process

    LKED[LKED - HEWL
Link Compiled Object Module with
System and Application Libraries to
Produce Final Executable Program]:::process

    %% Datasources
    DS1[(CardDemo COBOL Source Library
AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CBL)]:::datasource
    DS2[(CardDemo Copybook Library
AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.CPY)]:::datasource
    DS3[(CardDemo Compiler Listing Library
AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LISTING)]:::datasource
    DS4[(CardDemo Application Load Library
AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.LOADLIB)]:::datasource
    SPOOL[(System Print Spool
SYSOUT)]:::datasource

    END([Job End
Executable Program Successfully Built
and Deployed to CardDemo Load Library]):::final

    %% Main Flow
    START --> COMPILE

    %% COMPILE Step Datasource Interactions
    DS1 -.->|Read COBOL Source Program for Member &MEM| COMPILE
    DS2 -.->|Read Shared Copybook Definitions
Data Structures and Common Layouts| COMPILE
    COMPILE -.->|Write Compilation Listing
Source Map and Diagnostics| DS3
    COMPILE -->|Pass Compiled Object Module
to Linkage Editor| LKED

    %% CBLPRINT Step
    COMPILE --> CBLPRINT
    DS3 -.->|Read Compilation Listing
for Member &MEM| CBLPRINT
    CBLPRINT -.->|Print Full Compilation Report
Warnings and Errors| SPOOL

    %% LKED Step Datasource Interactions
    CBLPRINT --> LKED
    LKED -.->|Write Final Executable
Load Module for Member &MEM| DS4

    LKED --> END
